title: China vs EU on debt conditions
summary: A clip of Yanis Varoufakis answering a question about China versus the EU on debt conditions. He contrasts Chinese non-interventionist lending with EU conditionality, drawing on the Piraeus port.
why: Cited in threads on Chinese lending and the Belt and Road as an informed firsthand view from a former Greek finance minister.

quote.text: Here's a great clip of Varoufakis discussing the port of Piraeus
